title: PampaR: Cerebral Language Model with Territorial Architecture
description: PampaR is a brain-inspired language model that achieves perplexity ~45 with only 14M parameters on WikiText-103. It uses a novel territorial architecture with 4 specialized territories (Expressive, Contextual, Formal, Structural) coordinated by a central Thalamus using hybrid routing: 70% explicit rules (LLAVES) + 30% learned attention. Trained entirely on consumer hardware (GTX 1650 4GB VRAM).
notes: Experimental architecture for academic research. Outperforms LSTM (24M params, PPL 69.1) and Transformer-XL Small (24M params, PPL 54.5) with 42% fewer parameters.
references: Merity, S., Keskar, N.S., & Socher, R. (2018). Regularizing and Optimizing LSTM Language Models. ICLR.
Dai, Z., et al. (2019). Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models Beyond a Fixed-Length Context. ACL.
Vaswani, A., et al. (2017). Attention Is All You Need. NeurIPS.
